format.requirement: Approximately 4-8 main pages in NeurIPS template; references and appendices excluded; anonymity not required

clarity.evidence: Two central results, seven monochrome vector figures; exact specification moved to appendix

soundness.evidence: Equations checked against runtime; self-influence exclusions; fixed-prior matched controls; local/hosted/oracle protocols distinguished

analysis.evidence: 1/3/10 solver learning curves; paired core benchmark effects; broad43-source validation with whole-source-group bootstrap intervals; complete hosted budget curve

data.evidence: 167-source deployment fit, pinned revision, count summaries, source-group exclusions, duplicate limitations, access terms

reproducibility.evidence: Fitted archive, portable prior trainer, metric records and aggregation verifier; archived experiment input requirements documented
reproducibility.remaining: Archived representation experiments require rebuilding the aligned panels and original data-preparation caches.

attribution.evidence: Team Drift prior and baseline credited, MIT retained; standard statistical tools distinguished from integration; assistant use disclosed
